## Puente Piedra Air Pollution Data

uHoo: Device 1 and Device 4

We have created a new Partner account for uHoo and linked it to the premium account. This allows for access to the API and data downloads.
Resource for using the uHoo API: https://documenter.getpostman.com/view/180333/TVzNJesN

From Eder: The environmental evaluations from Puente Piedra were done between June and October 2022.

From the merged data, I see "fecha": April, 2022 to May 2023
